name: syna-workspace

scripts.clean: find packages apps -type d -name dist -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find packages apps -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -delete
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.json --pretty false && npm run type-tests
scripts.test:app: node --test apps/hyla-mini/tests/filesystem.test.mjs apps/hyla-mini/tests/render.test.mjs apps/hyla-mini/tests/tenants-auth.test.mjs apps/hyla-mini/tests/preflight.test.mjs apps/hyla-mini/tests/audit-app.test.mjs apps/hyla-mini/tests/review-app.test.mjs && node --test --expose-gc apps/hyla-mini/tests/site-manager.test.mjs
scripts.test:postgres: node scripts/pg-test-cluster.mjs with -- node --test apps/hyla-mini/tests/postgres.test.mjs apps/hyla-mini/tests/matrix.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:app && npm run test:scripts && npm run demo
scripts.benchmark:v05: npm run build && node --expose-gc benchmarks/v0.5-planning.mjs benchmarks/results-v0.5.0.json

description: Syna core, demos and the Hyla-mini application
